information_goal: Stability and all nine moment costs of two previously seen order-flow-memory hypotheses at the main 1000/200,3500-day scale. No parameter search, automatic winner, default promotion or extra worlds.

arms.role: Previously seen development hypothesis; not chosen from these 30 seeds

source.scope: Old archive is isolated without production edits. All 13 bare/validation/moment dependencies matched the active tree before freeze. Other archived disclosure/QL code is unrelated and is not qualified by this run.

runtime.timing: Initialization, instrumented run/step, measured inner recorder work, estimated step work after subtraction, statistics, archive write and total wall time are separate. Recording affects caches/scheduling; not a production speed benchmark or the old 2500-measurement-day <60-second gate.

gates.mechanical: Every company/day and every scheduled world; full-period zero caps, positive finite prices/values, cash/share conservation at frozen 1e-8 tolerance, no divergence
gates.stylized: All companies finite nine price moments, positive excess kurtosis and absolute-return ACF1, using existing frozen validate_market
gates.return_acf: pending; descriptive per-company distribution, no newly fitted threshold
gates.cross_asset_correlation: pending; descriptive, no arbitrary pass bounds
gates.empirical_calibration: pending; no empirical target fitting or claim
gates.holder_total_return: All nine moments and distributions reported separately; no silent substitution for price returns

pairing.unit: One seed is one paired world; firm index matches only within a seed
pairing.initialization: Hash all investor arrays, initial P/V and size classes plus decision schedule
pairing.external_inputs: Per-day digest of fundamental/noise RNG state, intrinsic values and unamplified noise state. Compare every common completed prefix; failed/partial worlds cannot claim full-horizon pairing.
pairing.endogenous: Prices, wealth, inventory, depth, volatility and orders may differ. Same seed alone does not establish path equality.
pairing.mismatch: Global stop; do not replace seed or continue under a changed contract

storage.cap: Full bool day-by-company mask; never truncated, including burn-in and observed partial failure day
storage.cash: Daily actual and expected cash. Expected cash is initial cash plus paid external dividends; complete-path reconstruction uses current-day V.
storage.share_error: Signed investor+noise+maker shares minus one, every observed asset/day
storage.feedback_state: Prequote sqrt(variance/reference_variance), drives noise multiplier (capped at ratio 4) and depth stress; exact EWMA levels are reconstructible from stored moves and initial config on completed days
storage.exogenous_digest: S32, one per observed day including day zero
storage.moments: Both price and externally dividend-inclusive nine-moment company matrices, float64 200x9; full-horizon moments remain unavailable for failed worlds
storage.event_selection: Chronological day then ascending firm index; only attribution details truncated, never cap mask or core paths
storage.retention: No old archives deleted; one shared isolated source, no full holdings/return duplication. At least 15GiB free after reserving all remaining output budget.

failure_policy.market: Caps remain outcomes and do not stop or add worlds. Numerical/model exceptions save observed prefix, stage flags and original exception; mark failed and continue other fixed cases.
failure_policy.infrastructure: Source, contract, pairing, storage or recorder consistency error globally stops with evidence. Unresolved running attempts or orphan artifacts are not silently rerun.
failure_policy.resume: --run skips terminal completed/failed records after hash checks; never retries a failed world. No within-world checkpoint replay. Stale writer locks require manual verification.
failure_policy.detailed_events: Always report total, saved and omitted events. No full flow/holding histories; event decomposition cannot identify all path counterfactuals.

stopping: Exactly 60 scheduled worlds, no replacements, additional seeds, candidate scans, threshold changes or automatic winner. Any model with missing/failed worlds cannot pass all-world gates.

return_definitions.dividend_interpretation: Existing external dividend injection; no invented ex-dividend adjustment. Continuing ex-dividend intrinsic-value-anchor interpretation remains unestimated.
return_definitions.measurement: Returns for days1201..3500, exactly2300 observations per completed company

cap_interpretation: max_log_return=.3 is the inherited hard log-quote truncation protocol; economic daily-limit justification has not been established. It implies simple price bounds -25.918%/+34.986%; a cap-only mechanical FAIL is not itself an accounting failure or proof of economic impossibility.

estimated_cost_before_run.historical_reference: The previously recorded 72 bare1000/200 worlds of6592 days had about208 seconds pure-market time. Linear scaling suggests about92 seconds for60x3500 before recorder/statistics/I/O, only a rough reference, not a measured estimate for this launcher.
estimated_cost_before_run.wall_time: Several minutes or more depending on recording/I/O/contention; no performance pass claim.

limits: Two model hypotheses were development-informed; new seeds test simulation robustness, not untouched empirical data.
Thirty seeds per model, not6000 independent company trials; zero failures do not prove rare-event stability.
Bare qualification cannot replace corporate expenditure, audit, financing, Q-learning or policy gates.
All nine price/holder moments and company distributions are disclosed; return ACF, cross-asset correlation and empirical calibration remain pending without justified frozen targets.
Five previously seen public stocks are neither a representative company sample nor an untouched holdout; no target is used by this launcher.
Current cap/mispricing guards and every failed world are retained; no parameter/seed search until gates pass.
Detailed attribution is bounded but all cap flags and core paths are complete through every observed step; no complete investor position histories are archived.
